title: Cladone Auth broker configuration
description: Optional multi-tenant OIDC issuer. The broker federates upstream identity providers, applies local policy and re-emits Ed25519-signed JWTs. Gate One trusts only the broker issuer. Secrets are read from the environment: a *Env field is required when no inline secret is accepted.

publicUrl.description: External origin of the broker, without a trailing slash (for example https://auth.example.com).

listen.description: Default listen address for cmd/cladone-auth (for example :8081).

sessionCookieName.description: Broker SSO cookie shared by all applications in one browser. Default cladone_broker_sid.

tenants.description: Isolated issuers. Each tenant has its own key, client, upstream identity providers and policy.

id.description: Tenant identifier; also the /t/{tenant} path segment and default audience.

clientId.description: Gate One OIDC client id registered with this tenant.

clientSecret.description: Inline client secret. Prefer clientSecretEnv so the secret never lands in the file.

clientSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the Gate One client secret.

redirectUris.description: Allowed Gate One callback URLs (https, or localhost for tests).

audiences.description: Audiences allowed for access tokens. Empty = the tenant id.

upstreams.description: Named OIDC upstreams (google, microsoft, …). The key is the idp authorize parameter and the chooser label.

keyFile.description: Active Ed25519 private key file (base64 raw seed). Empty = ephemeral key, tests/dev only. Mutually exclusive with keyFiles.

keyFiles.description: Published keys, oldest first, newest active. Used to rotate tokens without invalidating old ones.

defaultRoles.description: Roles granted to every authenticated user.

allowedDomains.description: Allowed upstream hosted/email domains. Empty = no restriction.

adminEmails.description: Email addresses granted the admin role.

groupRoles.description: Map an upstream group/claim value to broker roles.

accessTokenTtlSeconds.description: Access token lifetime in seconds. Default 600.

idTokenTtlSeconds.description: ID token lifetime in seconds. Default 600.

refreshTokenTtlSeconds.description: Refresh token lifetime in seconds. Default 2592000 (30 days). Gate One reads it from discovery to size revocation.

sessionTtlSeconds.description: Broker SSO session lifetime in seconds. Default 43200 (12 hours).

localAccounts.description: Enable the local account lifecycle endpoints (register, verify email) for this tenant. Requires smtp.

appOrigins.description: Allowed application origins for a verification continueUrl.

mappings.description: Ordered mapping rules translating upstream claims into broker roles/scopes/claims. Evaluated on every federated login; results are not persisted on the user. The legacy groupRoles block remains supported for the groups claim.

rules.description: when/then policy rules: test the incoming token's claims (when) and grant rights (then), including derived roles (rolesFrom) and copied claims (copyClaims). Evaluated on every login; results are not persisted on the user.

issuer.description: Upstream OIDC issuer. Default https://accounts.google.com for the google upstream; required for other upstreams.

clientId.description: Upstream OIDC client id. Prefer clientIdEnv.

clientIdEnv.description: Environment variable holding the upstream client id.

clientSecret.description: Inline upstream client secret. Prefer clientSecretEnv.

clientSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the upstream client secret.

prompt.description: Forwarded to the upstream authorize endpoint (for example select_account).

scopes.description: Upstream scopes. Default openid, profile, email.

displayName.description: Label shown on the identity provider chooser. Default: the upstream key.

optional.description: Skip this upstream when its client id/secret environment variables are empty, instead of refusing startup.

upstream.description: Upstream OIDC identity provider configuration. The google key defaults to the Google issuer; other keys require issuer, clientId/Env and clientSecret/Env.

redis.description: Shared store for flows, codes, refresh tokens and the revocation keyspace read by Gate One. Absent = in-memory store, single instance and tests only.

url.description: Redis URL (redis:// or rediss://). Mutually exclusive with sentinel mode.

masterName.description: Redis master name for Sentinel discovery.

sentinelUsername.description: ACL user for the Sentinel connections (sentinel mode only).

sentinelPasswordEnv.description: Environment variable holding the Sentinel password (sentinel mode only).

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable holding the Redis password.

prefix.description: Key prefix for broker state. Default cladone:broker:v1:.

authPrefix.description: Key prefix the broker writes revocations to, read by Gate One. Default cladone:auth:v1:.

tls.description: Use TLS for the Sentinel and master/replica connections.

tlsCaFile.description: CA bundle for TLS (system roots by default). Requires tls=true.

tlsServerName.description: TLS server name, useful when Sentinels are addressed by IP. Requires tls=true.

smtp.description: Outbound mail relay for local-account verification emails.

usernameEnv.description: Environment variable holding the SMTP username.

passwordEnv.description: Environment variable holding the SMTP password.

claim.description: Dot path into the upstream token claims, for example groups, realm_access.roles or resource_access.gate-one.roles.

values.description: Values to match. If omitted, the rule matches when the claim is present and non-empty.

roles.description: Broker roles added when the rule matches.

scopes.description: Broker scopes added when the rule matches.

claims.description: Claims copied into issued tokens when the rule matches. Reserved claims (iss, sub, aud, exp, iat, jti, nonce, tenant, roles, scope, sid, email, preferred_username) are refused.

rule.description: A when/then policy rule: test the incoming token's claims and grant rights. Evaluated on every login; results are not persisted on the user.

when.description: Conditions, combined with logical AND. A single condition object is also accepted as shorthand.

condition.description: Test one claim of the incoming token.

claim.description: Dot path into the upstream token claims (email, sub, groups, realm_access.roles, ...).

match.description: Matching operator. Default exact. prefix/suffix/domain/glob are case-insensitive.

values.description: Values to match. Omitted = the claim must be present and non-empty.

then.description: Rights granted when every condition matches.

claims.description: Constant claims copied into issued tokens. Reserved claims are refused.

rolesFrom.description: Derive roles from an incoming claim's values.

copyClaims.description: Copy incoming claims into issued tokens, optionally renamed and reshaped.

rolesFrom.description: Turn an incoming claim's values into broker roles.

copyClaim.description: Copy an incoming claim into the issued token.
